explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions: RelativeGroupLaw, KernelTrivial, LocIsoOnBase and negMor. It says these properties carry over along a group-law homomorphism that fits into a pullback square of schemes. Mathlib has no counterpart to these definitions, so it cannot contain this result. The proof uses Mathlib infrastructure only as glue (IsInvertible.pullback, Scheme.Modules.pullbackTensorObjIso, pullbackComp and pullbackCongr). The substantive steps come from library lemmas: kernelTrivial_of_isPullback, LocIsoOnBase.pullback_of_comp_eq, negMor_comp and locIsoOnBase_of_iso. No separate search of Mathlib was run.
